body: @spinscale thanks for reporting. Let me fix this.
Actually the scope of this needs to be broaden as we need to also ensure property access works in the static initializer. So this will be a bigger change.
@normanmaurer - Lets fix this one and any others we can think of.  If we suspect this is a systemic problem lets open another issue to catch the remainder.
@spinscale cool! Was this the only problem you needed to fix to get it run with a SecurityManager ?

yes, mainly due to having specific permissions on how to access files, we dont do any property based security. You can see our policy file at https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/master/dev-tools/tests.policy
